# Implementation Plan: Stable Benchmark Preset for Local LLM CLI

## 1. Overview

This plan defines a reproducible, stable benchmarking mode for a local LLM CLI (e.g., `llama-cli`, `llama-bench`, or a custom wrapper). The goal is to produce consistent, comparable performance metrics across runs, models, and hardware configurations, with clear separation of prefill and decode phases.

---

## 2. Command Shape

### CLI Interface

```bash
llama-bench \
  --preset stable \
  --model <model_path> \
  --prompt-file <prompt_file> \
  --output <output_json> \
  [--warmup-runs N] \
  [--benchmark-runs N] \
  [--context-size N] \
  [--batch-size N] \
  [--threads N] \
  [--compare-llama-cpp] \
  [--verbose]
```

### Preset Definition (`stable`)

The `stable` preset encodes fixed parameters to ensure reproducibility:

| Parameter | Value | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `warmup_runs` | 3 | Discard initial
